scope.supports: General finite algebraic purity/positivity and conditional Baker dichotomy kernel theorems; exact selected rational spectrum, Renyi and log-series certificates.
scope.does_not_support: An unconditional proof of Baker or transcendence from a native flag, base-two entropy claims, or a kernel-verified finite-tail array transport.
scope.narrowest_claim: Literal general-dimension source entropy signatures with explicit Baker hypothesis, plus five exact rational series computations with an explicit analytic remainder argument.
scope.next_test: Recompute each rational series/tail/width and challenge both units and hypothesis promotion.
